name: thebizgift
description: The Biz Gift -- static site, no build step. This package.json exists solely so api/cron/refresh-cache.js can use @vercel/blob to mirror Airtable images into Vercel Blob storage (Layer 5 of the Airtable caching architecture -- see CLAUDE.md). No other file in this repo depends on it, and there is no build/start script -- the site itself remains plain HTML/CSS/JS with no bundler.
